# SiteKit

> Canonical source documentation for the framework's public core and Cloudflare candidate. Registry publication of the framework is pending; Appkit 0.2.0 is available on npmjs.

Documentation portal: [https://tech-docs.alneas.com/sitekit/](https://tech-docs.alneas.com/sitekit/). English guides and source JSDoc are maintained in this project; the portal aggregates the approved public sources.

The installed core package also includes `llms-full.txt` (generated public guides) and `skills/sitekit/SKILL.md` (consumer agent instructions). Match guidance to the installed package version or verified candidate. Portal links do not establish that its default released documentation includes this unpublished candidate; use the packaged guides and declarations when revisions differ.

The approved documentation and source entrypoints are listed in docs.manifest.json. Runtime signatures and method behavior are canonical in source JSDoc. This index is navigation only, not a replacement for type declarations or API reference. Private guides and operator/customer evidence are excluded.
